**`pad` and `gap` are panel words with a preset row AND a free-value knob — a body can finally take its own padding.** `glyphs.js`: new rail-only `pad` row (`0 · 0.5em · 1em · 2em`, `--panel-pad`, no `modes` — always live), `knob: true` on both `pad` and `gap`. `panel.css`'s existing `.panel-body` rule gains `padding: var(--panel-pad, 0)` — no `Panel.defaults` entry, on purpose, so an untouched body still inherits the `--panel-pad: 1em` `PanelDrag`'s centre-drop nest already writes on its container (yesterday's landing, now consumed). `properties.js` grew a copied (not imported — `ext/Panel` depends on nothing in `ext/layout`) `knob()`: a range slider beside the preset row, seeded from the item's stored value or the body's live cascade, committing on `change` (not `input` — the first draft rebuilt the whole rail on every drag tick and dropped the slider's own pointer capture). The bar's pop stays presets-only; `word_vars()`/`live_words()` already tolerate a value outside `names` with no change needed.

Proved headless (`pad-gap-probe.mjs`, scratchpad — builds a MemorySaver `Panel` tree via `import()` in `page.evaluate`, no new route needed): preset → computed padding matches; knob to a free value → computed follows, no preset lit, `item.get('pad')` reads the free value; `gap`'s knob under `flex` → computed `gap` follows; `Item.open()` on the same saver after `save()` restores `pad`/`gap`/`display` alike. Zero console errors on the Panel page and both touched doc pages at 1600.
